D: Smaug attacks Lake-town and armies gather at the Lonely Mountain to fight over its treasure.
P: Serve the mains when the people of Lake-town shelter in the ruins of Dale.
S: Rye crispbread spread with crème fraîche, topped with smoked trout, dill and thinly sliced pickled onion.
the survivors camping in the ruins of Dale
Damper of self-raising flour, butter and milk, baked at 200C for 30 minutes, torn and served with butter and golden syrup.
the dwarves of the Iron Hills
Mini beef pies of mince and gravy in shortcrust bases with puff lids, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
M: Erebor roast beef and Yorkshire puddings
the dwarves take back their halls
Roast beef sliced pink with puffed Yorkshire puddings and gravy. Roast a 1.5kg beef sirloin at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 40 minutes and rest.
Thranduil's elves arriving at the mountain
Chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and herbs, with roasted root vegetables and a herb salad.
W: Bilbo finally home at Bag End
Apples and blackberries cooked with sugar under an oat crumble, baked at 180C for 35 minutes, with custard.
K: English breakfast tea brewed in a pot with milk, and a slice of the seed cake.

s.how: Spread rye crispbreads with creme fraiche. Flake 200g smoked trout over the top. Finish each with a sprig of dill and a few thin rings of pickled onion. Serve on a wooden board like a fisherman's supper from the lake.

s.note: the dwarves of the Iron Hills
s.how: Brown 500g beef mince with a diced onion, add 250ml beef stock and simmer until thick, then cool. Line a muffin tin with shortcrust rounds, fill and top with puff pastry lids. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes and serve with tomato sauce.

m.n: Erebor roast beef and Yorkshire puddings
m.note: the dwarves take back their halls
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg beef sirloin at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 40 minutes and rest. Heat oil in a muffin tin at 230C, pour in a batter of 140g flour, 4 eggs and 200ml milk and bake 20 minutes. Make gravy from the pan juices with 300ml stock.

w.note: Bilbo finally home at Bag End
w.how: Peel and slice 4 green apples and cook with 250g blackberries and 50g brown sugar for 5 minutes. Spoon into a dish. Rub 100g butter into oats, flour and 100g brown sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes and serve with warm custard.

d.how: Warm the teapot with boiling water and tip it out. Add 4 tea bags and fill with freshly boiled water, then steep for 4 minutes under a tea cosy. Pour into cups with a splash of milk and serve with a slice of cake at the round green door.
